programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    threshold = 0.72

    def mode_and_ratio(values):
        color, count = Counter(values).most_common(1)[0]
        return color, count / len(values)

    row_modes = [mode_and_ratio(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [mode_and_ratio([grid[r][c] for r in range(height)]) for c in range(width)]
    candidate_colors = {
        color
        for color, ratio in row_modes + col_modes
        if ratio >= threshold
    }
    scores = {}
    for color in candidate_colors:
        row_count = sum(mode == color and ratio >= threshold for mode, ratio in row_modes)
        col_count = sum(mode == color and ratio >= threshold for mode, ratio in col_modes)
        if row_count and col_count:
            scores[color] = row_count + col_count
    line_color = min(scores, key=scores.get)

    line_rows = [i for i, (mode, ratio) in enumerate(row_modes)
                 if mode == line_color and ratio >= threshold]
    line_cols = [i for i, (mode, ratio) in enumerate(col_modes)
                 if mode == line_color and ratio >= threshold]
    vertices = [[grid[r][c] for c in line_cols] for r in line_rows]
    active_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(vertices)
                   if any(value != line_color for value in row)]
    active_cols = [j for j in range(len(line_cols))
                   if any(vertices[i][j] != line_color for i in range(len(line_rows)))]
    r0, r1 = min(active_rows), max(active_rows)
    c0, c1 = min(active_cols), max(active_cols)

    interior = [grid[r][c] for r in range(height) if r not in line_rows
                for c in range(width) if c not in line_cols]
    base_color = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]

    output = []
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        row = []
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            corners = (vertices[i][j], vertices[i][j + 1],
                       vertices[i + 1][j], vertices[i + 1][j + 1])
            value = corners[0] if len(set(corners)) == 1 and corners[0] != line_color else base_color
            row.append(value)
        output.append(row)
    return output
'''
